name: superdocs
description: Typebar (formerly SuperDocs), the document harness for your AI: edit, draft, search, summarize and export styled documents (.docx / PDF / HTML / Markdown / plain text) via the Typebar MCP server. Single install bundles 38 MCP tools, 4 user-invocable workflow prompts and a skill that auto-loads when document work is requested.

api_key.title: Typebar API Key
api_key.description: Your Typebar (formerly SuperDocs) sk_ API key from https://use.typebar.ai/ → Settings → API Keys → Create. Stored securely in your OS keychain (never in plaintext config). Free plan includes 500 AI operations per month.
